W3C 80% maskable safe-zone icon rasterizer (192px, 512px, apple-touch, maskable) with automatic branded fallback generation
Non-destructive in-place project injection with idempotence protection, standalone PWA ZIP export, and MultiBuild bundling
Studio UI Tab 10 'PWA Studio' featuring live reactive device mockups (Mobile Phone w/ Android 80% safe zone toggle, Desktop Window, Offline Screen)
